text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Let's do this again today!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road tackled her training with 
full enthusiasm, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: It just fell out of nowhere!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not again... Why does it only rain 
when I'm completely fired up...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Coupled with having her stamina drained by 
getting soaked in the rain, Narita Top 
Road showed clear signs of exhaustion.
